lessons.title: The Clarity Principle 🔍
lessons.description: Understand why specificity is the most important skill in prompt engineering.

lessons.title: Specifying the "What" 📌
lessons.description: Define the exact topic, scope, and key details to leave no room for misinterpretation.

lessons.title: Specifying the "How" 🛠️
lessons.description: Take full control over format, length, tone, and structure with precise descriptors.

lessons.title: Quantifiers, Limits & Boundaries 📏
lessons.description: Use numbers, lists, and explicit constraints to fence in the AI's output.

lessons.title: Banishing Ambiguity 🚫
lessons.description: Spot and eliminate fuzzy language, double meanings, and hidden assumptions.
